columns_wip_limit_consistency_check.name: columns_wip_limit_consistency_check
columns_wip_limit_consistency_check.value: ("columns"."wip_mode" = 'none' AND "columns"."wip_limit" IS NULL) OR ("columns"."wip_mode" IN ('warn', 'enforce') AND "columns"."wip_limit" IS NOT NULL AND "columns"."wip_limit" BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000)

oauth_transactions_link_binding_check.name: oauth_transactions_link_binding_check
oauth_transactions_link_binding_check.value: "oauth_transactions"."intent" = 'signin' OR ("oauth_transactions"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "oauth_transactions"."session_id" IS NOT NULL)

projects_archive_state_check.name: projects_archive_state_check
projects_archive_state_check.value: ("projects"."status" = 'active' AND "projects"."archived_at" IS NULL) OR ("projects"."status" = 'archived' AND "projects"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)
